name: Tania Malone
background: Tania Malone of Douglas ran in the 2022 Democratic primary for House District 6; she did not appear on the general-election ballot. No public-record occupation, education, or military service was found in the Secretary of State filings, the 2022 League of Women Voters statewide primary voter guide, or the other public records reviewed for this Profile.
